caption:
Meta just open-sourced the design system behind 13,000+ of its own apps 🤯

It’s called Astryx. Meta spent 8 years building it, and now you and your AI can build with the exact same pieces.

What you get 👇
• 150+ ready-made components: buttons, forms, tables, page templates
• 7 themes you can change to your own brand colors
• Dark mode built in
• A command your AI uses to look up every component, so it builds with the same parts you do

⭐ 13,000+ stars in a single week · free and open source (MIT), React, in beta

💬 Comment “META” and I’ll send you the link
